subject: Request: temporary payment carveout for 90-day pilot — Aegis Labs
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@aegislabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aegislabs.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice path instead of PO

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Aegis Labs is excited to kick off a 90-day pilot. Our procurement cycle is quite slow right now (procure team estimates ~8–10 weeks for a formal PO), and we asked whether Redwood can accept invoice-only billing for the pilot so we can start integrations immediately.

Specific asks:
- Temporary invoice-only path for the 90-day pilot (est. spend $3k–6k/mo).
- A short pilot addendum outlining scope, billing cadence, and data handling commitments.
- Any evidence checklist your procurement/legal team needs (SOC 2, DPA, etc.) so we can share internally.

I attached our completed onboarding form and a redacted vendor intake note. We can sign an addendum or limited SOW if that helps. Let me know what information you need and whether Redwood can approve a temporary carveout.

Best,
Julia Park
Procurement Lead | Aegis Labs
Attachments: aegis_onboarding_form.pdf, aegis-redacted-vendor-note.txt
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@aegislabs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice path instead of PO

Hi Julia — thanks for the form and for the clear ask. Appreciate the context on procurement timing.

Short answer: we can consider a temporary invoice-only billing path for a bounded pilot, provided we have the right controls in place. To move forward I need the following from your side:
1) Confirmation of the pilot ARR range (you mentioned $3k–6k/mo; please confirm a not-to-exceed).
2) The signed pilot addendum (we can draft and push to DocuSign).
3) Requested evidence: SOC 2 Type II report or an attestation, and confirmation on data residency (we can accommodate US).

Internal note: looping in Naomi (Procurement Ops) for approval matrix and Priyom on contracting/timing.

Proposed interim policy: Redwood can accept invoicing for the 90-day pilot with a maximum monthly invoice of $5,000 and preapproved evidence. We will run invoices on 30-day cadence and reserve the right to require a PO for continued usage beyond the pilot. If that works, we will prepare a one-page addendum describing the carveout, billing cadence, and termination rights.

Julia — can you confirm the not-to-exceed and that Aegis will provide SOC 2 attestation by the pilot start? Once confirmed, I will route to our approval committee.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head, Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: pilot-addendum-draft.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for invoice path instead of PO

Markus/Priyom — quick internal thread before I respond to Aegis.

Summary of risk controls I recommend for approving a temporary carveout:
- Limit pilot to 90 days max, auto-revert to PO requirement unless PO is delivered.
- Cap invoices at $5,000/month (exceptions need VP procurement sign-off).
- Require SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent attestation on Day 1 and a signed DPA.
- One-page signed pilot addendum that includes data handling and termination for nonpayment.

If we agree, I can approve at Procurement Ops level; anything above $5k/month or longer than 90 days will need escalation to finance. Priyom — confirm if sales is comfortable with $5k cap and one-page addendum obligations.

Naomi
Sr. Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@aegislabs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: 90-day pilot — temporary payment carveout (Aegis Labs)

Julia — good news. Procurement Ops has approved a temporary carveout under the controls below:

Approved carveout (summary):
- Duration: 90 days from pilot start date.
- Billing: invoice-only, net 30 cadence; Redwood will invoice monthly.
- Financial cap: not-to-exceed $5,000 per month.
- Evidence: Aegis to provide SOC 2 Type II attestation (or equivalent) and signed DPA on or before pilot start.
- Agreement: sign the attached one-page pilot addendum (we will send via DocuSign).
- Reversion: If PO is provided within 90 days, we'll switch billing to PO terms; absent PO, procurement policy will reapply and we may pause service.

I've attached the pilot-addendum-draft.pdf for your review — this contains the scope and standard payment terms. Please confirm the monthly not-to-exceed (so I can lock the cap), sign the addendum when ready, and share SOC 2 attestation. Once I have that, I will issue the first invoice schedule and notify Finance.

Looking forward to getting Aegis started.

—Markus
Head, Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pilot-addendum-draft.pdf
